trailhead.label: Start here: Albens cemetery parking, Entrelacs (do not park at the D1201 trail entrance, it is prohibited)

cautions: About 1 km on quiet country lanes.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Start here: Albens cemetery parking, Ent: Parti da qui: parcheggio del cimitero di Albens, Entrelacs (non parcheggiare all'ingresso del sentiero sulla D1201, è vietato)
Circa 1 km su tranquille stradine di campagna.
